query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!: i64", min(period) AS "first: String",
                  max(period) AS "last: String",
                  CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT amount_cents) = 1 THEN max(amount_cents) END
                      AS "amount: i64"
           FROM rule_bill_code WHERE rule_id = ?1 AND retired_at IS NULL
